character: Australia's largest ski resort by area, linking Perisher Valley, Smiggin Holes, Guthega and Blue Cow in Kosciuszko National Park in the New South Wales Snowy Mountains. The Skitube rack railway climbs from Bullocks Flat to Perisher Valley and Blue Cow. It is owned by Vail Resorts and included without day limits on the Epic Pass.
learning: Reference note: each area has beginner terrain and the resort runs a ski and snowboard school; a $99 beginner lift ticket was offered on opening weekend 2026. Confirm 2027 lesson products and prices.

source.note: Official homepage news (read 2026-10-03): "25 September 2026 Today marks the final day of Winter 2026 at Perisher." Opening Sat 6 Jun 2026 from Perisher news "Welcome to winter 2026" (earlier search summary).

season.typicalText: The season traditionally starts on the King's Birthday long weekend in early June (6 Jun 2026) and runs to early October (scheduled close 4 Oct 2026).
season.notes: Southern Hemisphere: Piste season id 2026-27 is the June–October 2027 winter (the one the 2026-27 Ikon and Epic passes cover); 2025-26 is the 2026 winter and 2024-25 the 2025 winter. No 2027 opening or closing date was found as of 2026-09-30. Australian resorts traditionally open on the King's Birthday long weekend — in 2027 that is Sat 12 – Mon 14 June (calendar inference, not an announcement). In the very poor 2026 season Perisher was one of the last Australian resorts still operating in September. Winter 2026 ended 25 Sep 2026 (official), earlier than the scheduled 4 Oct. OnTheSnow gives an estimated 2027 season 5 Jun – 3 Oct 2027 (estimate, not an announcement).
